summary: Iteration 7 — X (Twitter) OAuth 2.0 PKCE + ImageViewer rewrite + Snapchat pending badge. Backend: 9/9 pytest green. /api/auth/x/start returns a valid https://twitter.com/i/oauth2/authorize URL with state, code_challenge (S256) and proper redirect_uri. /api/auth/x/callback correctly 400s on unknown state and 422s on missing fields. Auth regression (register, login, admin login, forgot-password) all pass. Frontend: /login renders Google + X (real) + Snapchat(قيد المراجعة badge) buttons with data-testids. Clicking X triggers GET /api/auth/x/start which returns the real twitter URL. Snapchat click shows the 'قيد المراجعة' pending-review alert. ImageViewer on /listing/{id}: 56x56 red close button, prev/next, zoom in/out, 8 thumbnails with ring-highlight, clicking image no longer auto-zooms, thumb click navigates, close button exits viewer. Touch handlers (onTouchStart/onTouchEnd) wired in React. /auth/x/callback route registered — page renders (not 404).

issues: Minor: uses native window.alert() for Snapchat pending-review notice — consider upgrading to an in-app toast/modal for consistency with the rest of the app's RTL/themed UI.
X start error handler uses alert('تعذر بدء تسجيل الدخول بـ X — تأكد من إعدادات Developer Portal'). Should use the same error-toast pattern as the rest of the app.

action_items: Cosmetic: Replace alert()s in SocialLoginButtons with the app's toast system (Sonner already used elsewhere).
When Snap Kit Review approves Snapchat login, remove the 'قيد المراجعة' badge and the snapPending handler — replace with a real startSnap() call to /auth/snap/start.
Consider adding an explicit test that opens twitter.com in an iframe — not feasible automatically since Twitter blocks iframe embedding. Manual verification only.

Consider storing X's redirect_uri origin in backend .env (FRONTEND_URL) instead of deriving from request.base_url when FRONTEND_URL is empty, to avoid mismatch with Twitter Dev Portal's registered callback.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: /auth/x/start uses secrets.token_urlsafe for state + 96-char code_verifier with SHA-256 challenge — correct PKCE per RFC 7636.
Good: /auth/x/callback rotates state (delete_one after lookup) — prevents replay.
Good: state records carry expires_at (10 min TTL) and the handler checks expiration with tz-aware datetime normalization.
Minor: /auth/x/callback uses Basic auth for token exchange while also including client_id in the body; Twitter accepts either but this is technically redundant (harmless).
Minor: `placeholder_email = f"x_{x_id}@x.local"` will prevent future email-based communications to these users; consider prompting user to set a real email after first X login.
Minor: server.py now 1892 lines — still past 700-line guideline. Recommend modularizing X/Google/auth into /backend/routes/auth.py.
No MongoDB _id leaks in callback response (user.pop('_id', None) is done). Good.
ImageViewer.js: touch swipe uses simple delta-X threshold with RTL direction handling; thumbnails use active-ring indicator; zoom clamped 1-4x — clean implementation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login social buttons, /auth/x/callback route, ImageViewer all verified)

Verify manually: click X button on /login → redirects to twitter.com/i/oauth2/authorize → after user authorizes, returns to /auth/x/callback?code=...&state=... → XAuthCallback.js POSTs to /api/auth/x/callback → session cookies set.
